title: Bitcoin Core WASM tools and independent Contract Verifier · HODLXXI
description: Browser-based Bitcoin Core tools: offline wallet, vault and PSBT checks, plus a public-data-only contract inspector with explicit, optional Esplora funding lookup.

apps.title: Bitcoin Core wallet check: prove a wallet.dat opens, offline, in your browser
apps.description: Drop a wallet file, or try one of seven demo wallets: it is imported by an unmodified Bitcoin Core 31.1 running in a Linux VM emulated in the tab, with no network device. Nothing is uploaded.
apps.image_alt: Bitcoin Core wallet check: an encrypted demo wallet imported and unlocked offline, every step marked ok
apps.name: Bitcoin Core wallet check
apps.tagline: Prove a wallet.dat opens in Bitcoin Core: restored or migrated by a real bitcoind, unlocked with your passphrase, its descriptors and addresses listed.

apps.title: Vault recovery check: verify an AnchorWatch recovery kit with Bitcoin Core, offline, in your browser
apps.description: Upload a Trident Vault recovery kit: an unmodified Bitcoin Core 31.1, running offline in a Linux VM emulated in the tab, validates its descriptors, builds the watch-only wallet, lists your receive and change addresses and lets you download the wallet. Nothing is uploaded.
apps.name: AnchorWatch vault recovery check
apps.tagline: Upload a Trident Vault recovery kit: Bitcoin Core validates the descriptors, builds the watch-only wallet, lists your addresses and hands the wallet back.
apps.image_alt: Vault recovery check: Bitcoin Core 31.1 accepts an AnchorWatch vault, its checksums, import, addresses and export marked ok

apps.title: PSBT finalizer: combine and finalize PSBTs with Bitcoin Core, offline, in your browser
apps.description: Paste or drop partially signed Bitcoin transactions: an unmodified Bitcoin Core 31.1, offline at block 0 in a Linux VM in the tab, combines them, reports what's missing and finalizes them, timelocked spends included. No wallet, no keys, nothing uploaded.
apps.name: PSBT finalizer
apps.tagline: Combine signers' PSBTs, see what each input still needs, and finalize with finalizepsbt. Timelocked spends finalize at block 0: the locktime is checked against the transaction, not the chain.
apps.image_alt: PSBT finalizer: a timelocked PSBT finalized at block 0, broadcastable from 17 March 2030

apps.title: Bitcoin Contract Verifier: independently decode P2WSH scripts and check funding
apps.description: Use unmodified offline Bitcoin Core to inspect public HODLXXI P2WSH scripts (including legacy_777 human and current_144 operator-agent patterns), with optional Esplora funding lookup.
apps.name: Bitcoin Contract Verifier
apps.tagline: Decode P2WSH scripts and raw descriptors, inspect 777- or 144-block timelock paths, derive addresses with Bitcoin Core, and optionally query reported UTXOs.

links.name: v86_64 machine manager
links.tagline: The emulator these tools run on: x86-64 Linux in WebAssembly with a 64-bit JIT. Pick an ISO and boot it.

image_alt: wasm-bitcoin-tools: the Bitcoin Core wallet check, the AnchorWatch vault recovery check and the PSBT finalizer, run offline in the browser
